patch_description: This crossover keeps the inspiration program’s minimum one-parameter circuit while retaining the current program’s trainable correlation processing. A single shared angle drives both the collective RY mixer and the nearest-neighbour ZZ ring, giving only three total parameters including readout gain and bias. The fixed Möbius CZ network preserves broad local and long-range connectivity. Removing the separate RZ layer keeps the block at 28 gates, matching the lower-gate inspiration candidate while replacing local phase processing with correlation-sensitive ZZ rotations that may improve hard-group separation.
